names.description:
Pre-computed names per {@link Workflow.Vertex}.
- {@link Workflow.Action} refers to temporary {@link Data} prefixed with "tmp_df"
- {@link Workflow.Const} refers to cached {@link Data} referring to either "df1" or "df2"

data.description: Set of Data.Modin referenced by name referenced in generated {@link #ast}

vars.description: Mapping of variable names to their values to be used by the PyAst Executor

wf.description: Graph context used to query vertices

ast.description: Module that is iteratively built throughout visitor implementation

ioMethod.description: This specifies the method that should be used for an execution engine when performing an io operation.

doNotConvertStatementToNative.description: specify whether output of each statement should be converted back to its native data structure
